page.title: Hirschsprung's disease
about: Hirschsprung's disease is a rare bowel condition that is mainly diagnosed in babies and young children. Read about the symptoms, causes and treatments.

lines.text: See a GP if your baby or child has symptoms of Hirschsprung's disease.
Hirschsprung's disease can be serious if left untreated, so it's important to get help as soon as possible.
If your GP suspects the condition, they'll refer you to hospital for tests to confirm the diagnosis.
Call 999 or go to your nearest A&E if your child has symptoms of Hirschsprung's disease, as well as:
a high temperature of 38C or more
These could be the signs of a bowel infection (enterocolitis), which can be serious and lead to sepsis.
